text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- General election called for October 26. Early poll hides "impending problems", says opposition Labour leader Alfred Sant. Accuses government of hiding a deteriorating tourism industry and delays in Malta's application to join the European Union.
- The elections will see seasoned campaigner, Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami, facing Alfred Sant, leading the Labour Party into an election for the first time.
- Alfred Sant lists Labour's priorities for October 26 general elections.
- Prime minister says poll called early because of growing anxiety.
- Focus on election announcement - with pictures of all candidates of ruling Nationalist Party and supplement on achievements of Nationalist government in the past five years.
